commands.name: decrypt

options.name: --audit-log
options.description: Write detailed audit information to a separate log  file. Rolls on 10 MB with up to 7 retained files.

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing output files (default: refuse  existing outputs)

options.name: --id
options.description: The id of the key to use for decryption.(default:  "")

options.name: --json
options.description: Write a machine-readable JSON report to stdout  (schemaVersion 1); human output goes to stderr

options.name: --key
options.description: The file containing the RSA private key in XML or PEM  format (encrypted PKCS#8 PEM supported)

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory or file path (default: adds  .decrypted to original filename)

options.name: --passphrase-env
options.description: Read the private-key passphrase from the named  environment variable

options.name: --passphrase-file
options.description: Read the private-key passphrase from the first line of the given file

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress informational output (warnings and errors are still shown)

options.name: --require-sealed
options.description: Treat sessions without a verified end-of-log seal  (crashed, truncated, or v1-format) as errors: exit code 5, or an immediate  failure with --strict.

options.name: --strict
options.description: Fail immediately on first decryption error (default:  false, continues processing)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show additional diagnostic detail

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to encrypted log file, for a directory append  <PATH>\*.log or <PATH>\*.txt (Not recursive)

commands.description: Decrypt encrypted log files using an RSA private key. Exit codes: 0 success, 1 runtime failure, 2 usage error or refused overwrite, 3 no  files matched, 4 nothing decrypted, 5 --require-sealed not met.

commands.name: generate

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing key files (default: refuse if key  files exist)

options.name: --format
options.description: The encoding format (Pem or Xml) for the RSA keys  (default: Pem). Xml is legacy and requires --plaintext.

options.name: --key-size
options.description: The size of the RSA key in bits (default: 3072)

options.name: --output
options.description: The output path to write the public/private key pair

options.name: --passphrase-env
options.description: Read the private-key passphrase from the named  environment variable

options.name: --passphrase-file
options.description: Read the private-key passphrase from the first line of the given file

options.name: --plaintext
options.description: Write the private key unencrypted (required for Xml  format). Default is a passphrase-encrypted PKCS#8 private key.

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Suppress informational output (warnings and errors are still shown)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show additional diagnostic detail

commands.description: Generate a new RSA key pair for log encryption. The  private key is passphrase-encrypted (PKCS#8 PEM) unless --plaintext is passed.
